title: Live Git Status Streaming, Sidebar Explorer Toggle & Resilient Agent Concurrency
summary: Introduces real-time Git status streaming via Server-Sent Events with in-place badge patching, automatic closing of discarded diff tabs, a sidebar file/changes explorer toggle, and robust process-group cancellation for inline agent edits.

categories.name: Live Git Status Streaming & Diff Management
items: Real-time git status streaming to the browser using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and debounced file system watching
In-place DOM updates for sidebar git status badges and dirty folder markers without reloading the file tree
Automatic tab closure in diff view whenever modified files are checked out, reset, or committed externally
Intelligent fallback from changed-only sidebar filter to full file tree view when the repository becomes clean
Fixed active tab index drift when closing tabs positioned to the left of the currently focused editor tab

categories.name: Sidebar Explorer & UI Polish
items: Toggle switch in the sidebar header to switch seamlessly between the complete file explorer and modified git changes
Clean-state indicators disabling git changes and diff buttons with informative tooltips when no working tree changes exist
Contextual tooltips across UI navigation and action buttons for improved discoverability

categories.name: Inline Agent Concurrency & Cancellation
items: Process group termination and WaitDelay timeouts on cancellation to prevent hung pipes and orphaned subprocesses
Guaranteed job flag cleanup using Go defer semantics to ensure background agent slots never get stuck
Immediate running-flag reset upon user cancellation so new inline edit requests can start without delay
Conflicting job diagnostics with an inline cancel button in agent edit error banners
Unlocked harness and model selection dropdowns while background jobs are running

categories.name: Benchmarking & Tooling Reliability
items: Guaranteed index readiness polling via /api/meta before benchmark execution, preventing measurement races on unindexed workspaces
Ensured git status stat cache warmup completes before capturing file counts and index timing metrics
Added test suites for real-time git streaming events, repository change detection, and CLI commit handling
Documented pre-release verification protocols and release sequencing rules in developer documentation
